software-mansion-argent-argent-android-e.description: Boot an Android emulator and find its serial with Argent. Use when no Android emulator is running yet or you need to pick and boot one.

software-mansion-argent-argent-create-e2.description: Create, record, edit, replay, or repair reusable Argent e2e test YAML files. Use when the user asks to record, replay, or run an e2e test or repeatable path, set up profiling/A-B comparison, or before repeating 3+ interactions. For one-off UI checks, writing QA regression tests, or screen video, use argent-test-ui-flow, argent-qa-e2e, or argent-screen-recording.

software-mansion-argent-argent-device-in.description: Drive iOS, Android, or Chromium apps with Argent MCP tools. Use when tapping, swiping, typing, launching apps, waiting for UI, or taking screenshots (not for TV targets).

software-mansion-argent-argent-ios-devic.description: Drive a physical iPhone with Argent. Use when targeting a physical iPhone (list-devices kind "device") and ONLY then, never a simulator. For setup/signing, use `argent-ios-device-setup`.
Set up a physical iPhone over USB or CoreDevice tunnel for Argent. Use when a physical iPhone is involved (kind "device") and ONLY then; never for a simulator.

software-mansion-argent-argent-ios-simul.description: Boot an iOS simulator and find its UDID with Argent. Use when no simulator is booted yet or you need to pick and boot one.

software-mansion-argent-argent-lens.description: Propose visual design variants for on-screen elements so the user can pick in Argent Lens. Use when presenting UI design alternatives or A/B choices.

software-mansion-argent-argent-macos-app.description: Drive a native Mac app (AppKit, SwiftUI, react-native-macos, Catalyst) with Argent. Use when targeting platform "macos" or a native macOS app, never iOS or Electron/Chromium.

software-mansion-argent-argent-metro-deb.description: Debug JS with Argent in React Native (iOS, Android, Vega, macOS) or Chromium/Electron (CDP). Use when reading console logs, inspecting React trees, evaluating JS, or checking HTTP requests.

software-mansion-argent-argent-native-pr.description: Profile native CPU hotspots, UI hangs, memory, and iOS launch time via Instruments (iOS/Mac) or Perfetto (Android). Use when diagnosing native performance issues.

software-mansion-argent-argent-qa-e2e.description: Write repeatable QA regression e2e tests from test cases, tickets, or acceptance criteria (iOS, Android, Chromium, Mac apps, Vega; not Apple TV/Android TV). Use when the user asks to write, automate, or generate an e2e test or preserve a regression scenario. For one-off checks or replayable paths without criteria, use argent-test-ui-flow or argent-create-e2e.

software-mansion-argent-argent-react-nat.description: Develop and debug React Native apps on iOS simulator or Android emulator. Use when starting the app, debugging Metro, fixing builds, diagnosing runtime errors, or running tests.
Entry-point for React Native performance optimization; profiles first via `argent-react-native-profiler`. Use when the app feels slow, fixing re-renders or jank, or improving startup/TTI.
Profile a React Native Hermes app for JS re-renders and CPU hotspots via Argent profiler tools. Use when measuring before/after performance, diagnosing re-renders, or finding CPU hotspots.

software-mansion-argent-argent-screen-re.description: Record a screen video with Argent on iOS, Android, or Mac apps. Use when asked to capture a video clip of a flow, interaction, or animation.

software-mansion-argent-argent-screensho.description: Compare saved or live app screenshots via `screenshot-diff`. Use when checking visual regressions, before/after UI diffs, layout, typography, or rendering changes.

software-mansion-argent-argent-settings-.description: Grant, deny, or reset app runtime permissions out-of-band on an iOS simulator or Android device via `settings-permissions`. Use when the app's own dialog or toggle cannot change the permission.

software-mansion-argent-argent-test-ui-f.description: Autonomously verify one-off mobile UI flows (iOS/Android) with interact-screenshot-verify loops. Use when testing navigation, login, manual QA steps, or visible UI changes.

software-mansion-argent-argent-tv-intera.description: Control Apple TV (tvOS), Android TV (leanback), and Fire TV (Vega) via Argent (D-pad remote, focus tree, Vega JS debugging). Use when targeting runtimeKind "tv", platform "vega", or a TV app.
